question: A sum lent at compound interest amounts to 72.8% more than itself in 3 years, interest compounded annually at a certain rate per cent per annum. What will be the compound interest (in ₹) on a sum of ₹18,000 for 1 (1)/(2) years at the same rate, if the interest is compounded six-monthly?
solution:
Given:

A sum lent at compound interest amounts to 72.8% more than itself in 3 years, interest compounded annually at a certain rate per cent per annum.

Concept used:

1 (1)/(2) years = 1.5 years

1 year = 12 months

likewise 1.5 years = 1.5 × 12 months

In case of the compound interest,

Amount = P(1 + R/100)N

CI = P(1 + R/100)N - P

where

P = Principal amount

R = Rate of interest per year

N = Time in years

Calculation:

Let the principal amount and rate of interest be P and R% respectively.

According to the question,

P(1 + R/100)³ = P + P × 72.8%

⇒ P(1 + R/100)3 = P + P × 0.728
